pages.title: Chronal Anchor
pages.text: A heavy pendulum sealed in chronosteel that keeps my own clock ticking at its proper rate while the world outside speeds up or slows down. Proper time is personal in relativity; this makes sure mine stays mine. Its ticking is the calmest sound I have ever heard.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Inside a dilated time field my heartbeat and my thoughts drifted out of step. I tied a temporal knot to an arrow of time shard and fed it from a chronon capacitor, so my clock is referenced against itself rather than against the field.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Temporal Mechanics.
